title: 第1章 林知渔，嘎（PK中，求追读~求票票~）
slug: 每晚死在犯罪现场警局等我诈尸
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

耳边是大卡车开动的声音。

林知渔一睁开眼，就发现自己正坐在一辆卡车的副驾驶座上，眼前，是快速后退的夜景。

她不是在房间里睡觉吗？怎么跑这里来了？

“你怎么出现的？”

一道阴森森的声音响起。

林知渔后知后觉，转头看向了司机。

司机看上去很疲惫，眼底一片乌青，胡子拉碴的，但他在笑，嘴角几乎要咧到耳根。

车速越来越快。

林知渔的表情越来越惊悚。

“不过也不重要了，黄泉路上一起来做个伴吧！！”

林知渔心下一惊，猛地看向了前方——十字路口处，一群人正等红绿灯过马路。

“你要干什么？！”林知渔大喊道，“停下，快停下啊！”

随着尖叫声落下，司机扭转方向盘，直直地撞向了那群人。

“砰——”

前方的路人像是布娃娃一样，轻飘飘地飞向空中，而后重重落地，血液溅到了车窗上、车灯上、马路上。

瞬间，恐惧的尖叫声响彻整条街。

林知渔吓傻了。

卡车毫不留情地碾压地上的人，而后准备撞向对面没来得及驶离的几辆轿车。

林知渔咽了咽发紧的喉咙，也不知道哪里来的勇气，她起身去抢方向盘，司机下意识去挡，但不及她手快，方向盘猛地往右转动了一圈。

由于车速太快，方向盘打得太急，卡车在路口中心打了一个转，而后轰然翻倒在地，激起一片尘土。

车窗撞成碎片，悉数扎进了林知渔的脸上，其中一块比较大的玻璃直接刺穿了她的喉咙。

林知渔捂着喉咙，剧烈的疼痛袭来，她无助地张了张嘴，却如何都发不出声音来，直到意识消散的最后一刻，她听到了远方传来的警笛声。

林知渔，嘎。

酒店大床上，一名披头散发的女人猛地坐起，呼吸粗重，脸上冷汗涔涔。

那种尖锐的痛感密密麻麻钻透肌理，刺疼顺着神经疯狂蔓延至全身……好似亲身经历。

她伸手摸了摸脖子，好的。

Page (1/3)

The sound of a large truck driving was heard in my ears.

As soon as Lin Zhiyu opened his eyes, he found that he was sitting in the passenger seat of a truck. In front of him was a night scene that was rapidly receding.

Isn't she sleeping in the room?Why are you here?

"How did you show up?"

An eerie voice sounded.

Lin Zhiyu realized later and turned to look at the driver.

The driver looked tired, with black eyes and an unkempt beard, but he was smiling, almost reaching his ears.

The speed of the car is getting faster and faster.

Lin Zhiyu's expression became more and more horrifying.

"But it doesn't matter anymore, let's be a companion on the road to hell!!"

Lin Zhiyu was startled and suddenly looked ahead - at the intersection, a group of people were waiting for the traffic light to cross.

"What are you going to do?!" Lin Zhiyu shouted, "Stop, stop quickly!"

As the screams fell, the driver twisted the steering wheel and crashed straight into the group of people.

"Bang——"

The passers-by in front were like rag dolls, flying lightly into the air, and then landed heavily, with blood splattered on the car windows, car lights, and the road.

Instantly, screams of fear echoed throughout the street.

Lin Zhiyu was stunned.

The truck mercilessly crushed the people on the ground, and then prepared to ram into several cars on the opposite side that had not had time to move away.

Lin Zhiyu swallowed her tight throat. She didn't know where she got the courage. She stood up and grabbed the steering wheel. The driver subconsciously tried to block it, but was not as fast as her and the steering wheel suddenly turned to the right.

Because the speed was too fast and the steering wheel was turned too sharply, the truck spun in the center of the intersection and then flipped over to the ground, stirring up a cloud of dust.

The car window shattered into pieces, all of which pierced Lin Zhiyu's face. One of the larger pieces of glass directly pierced her throat.

Lin Zhiyu clutched her throat as severe pain hit her. She opened her mouth helplessly, but no sound came out. Until the last moment when her consciousness disappeared, she heard the sound of police sirens in the distance.

Lin Zhiyu, gah.

On the hotel bed, a woman with disheveled hair suddenly sat up, breathing heavily, with cold sweat on her face.

The sharp pain penetrated the texture densely, and the stinging pain spread crazily throughout the body along the nerves... It was like experiencing it personally.

She reached out and touched her neck, OK.
